presets.title: Make a set of UI sounds: click, hover and confirm
presets.summary: Three short synth UI sounds from one Decibel session, each rendered to its own SoundWave and MetaSound at one peak, measured and validated.
presets.prompt:
Make three {{style}} UI sounds from one Decibel session `{{content_folder}}/DS_UISet`: `SW_UI_Click` (a tick under 0.12 s), `SW_UI_Hover` (a soft high blip under 0.2 s) and `SW_UI_Confirm` (two rising notes under 0.5 s), each with a MetaSound. Follow the sound-design skill; if the sound_design pack (Decibel) is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_inspect with bCatalog, then with DeviceId gen.synth and each effect you use, for their parameter ids; never guess one.
2. One hyper_sound_apply_plan (bCreate true, fresh operationId): session.set Bpm 60 so a beat is a second; one instrument track per sound (track.add, device.add gen.synth, device.set for its tone); a clip.midi per sound at beats 0, 2 and 4 within its length limit; a small shared fx return that each track feeds with track.send. If a plan or render reply is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with its operationId.
3. hyper_sound_render three times, with StartSeconds 0, 2 and 4, DurationSeconds 0.3, 0.3 and 0.6, OutputPath {{content_folder}}/SW_UI_Click, _Hover and _Confirm, bMetaSound true and NormalizePeakDb {{peak}}.
4. hyper_audio_inspect the three SoundWaves with projection metrics, and hyper_audio_validate the three MetaSound Sources.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table, one row per sound: PeakDb {{peak}} (within 0.5), not clipped, not silent, LeadingSilenceSeconds under 0.01, notes within the length limit, no render Issues, MetaSound valid. List the asset paths.

presets.title: Design a sci-fi door whoosh with a filter sweep
presets.summary: A breathy synth whoosh whose filter opens and closes, a clunk at the end and a small room, rendered with a MetaSound and measured.
presets.prompt:
Make a sci-fi door-open sound from the Decibel session `{{content_folder}}/DS_{{name}}`: a 0.8-1.2 s airy whoosh whose filter opens then closes, and a mechanical clunk as it ends. Follow the sound-design skill; if the sound_design pack (Decibel) is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_memory_recall `audio loudness` for project conventions. hyper_sound_inspect with bCatalog, then DeviceId gen.synth, fx.filter and fx.verb for their parameter ids.
2. One hyper_sound_apply_plan (bCreate true, fresh operationId): session.set Bpm 60 and OneShot 1; a `Whoosh` instrument track (track.add, device.add gen.synth, device.set for a noisy, breathy tone) with a clip.midi note from beat 0 to 1, then device.add fx.filter whose cutoff a lane.set sweeps up over 0.4 s and down by 1 s (Curve below 0 on the fall); a `Clunk` track with a short low note at 0.9 beats; an fx return with fx.verb as a small room, fed by track.send. If a plan or render reply is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with its operationId.
3. hyper_sound_render with bMetaSound true, NormalizePeakDb -1 and TailSeconds 0.5.
4. hyper_audio_validate the MetaSound Source.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: length 1-1.7 s, PeakDb -1, not clipped, LeadingSilenceSeconds under 0.02, no render Issues, MetaSound valid, plus RmsDb. If the numbers show a problem (a drone, a late start), change one thing in a new session `DS_{{name}}_v2` and render again.

presets.title: Build a seamless ambience loop from library takes
presets.summary: Beds, placed spot sounds, one shared convolution space and moving lanes, rendered as a crossfaded loop with a looping MetaSound.

placeholders.name: library
placeholders.label: Sound library
placeholders.hint: a project folder of SoundWaves, or a folder of WAV files on disk

presets.prompt:
Make a seamless {{length}} s {{biome}} ambience loop from the Decibel session `{{content_folder}}/DS_Amb_Loop`, built as the sound-design skill's Ambience recipe from takes in `{{library}}`; if the sound_design pack (Decibel) is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_memory_recall `ambience`. hyper_sound_inspect with bCatalog and DeviceId fx.verb and fx.filter. Find beds (wind, leaves, insects) and spot sounds (birds, branches) in {{library}}; if there is no bed, say which are missing and stop.
2. One hyper_sound_apply_plan (bCreate true, fresh operationId): session.set Bpm 60, Loop 1, LoopStartBeat 0, LoopEndBeat {{length}}; 2-3 audio bed tracks (track.add) whose clip.audio runs the whole loop plus 4 s; 4-8 spot sounds well inside the loop, spread with track.set Pan; one fx return with device.add fx.verb on a forest impulse response if the library has one; every track feeding it with track.send (spots more than beds); a lane.set volume gust on the wind and a pan lane flying one bird across. If a plan or render reply is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with its operationId.
3. hyper_sound_render with DurationSeconds {{length}}, LoopCrossfadeSeconds 4, bLoop true, bMetaSound true and NormalizePeakDb -6.
4. hyper_audio_inspect the SoundWave with projection metrics, and hyper_audio_validate the MetaSound.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: length {{length}} s (within 0.05); no loop or click Issue; PeakDb -6; RmsDb between -30 and -18; no leading silence; spot sounds spread across the loop (list their beats). List the asset paths.

presets.title: Design a layered melee impact with an AAA stack
presets.summary: Anticipation, a frame-zero snap, meat, sub-thud and material layer, a debris tail and one space, measured window by window, then rendered.

placeholders.name: library
placeholders.label: Sound library
placeholders.hint: a project folder of SoundWaves, or a folder of WAV files on disk

presets.prompt:
Design a hammer hit on {{material}} from the Decibel session `{{content_folder}}/DS_{{name}}`, as the sound-design skill's AAA stack, from takes in `{{library}}`; if the sound_design pack (Decibel) is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_inspect with bCatalog and the DeviceIds you use (gen.synth, fx.lowend, fx.filter, fx.verb, fx.limit, fx.shaper). Pick a take per layer, or build it from gen.synth.
2. One hyper_sound_apply_plan (bCreate true, fresh operationId), each layer its own track (track.add, clip.audio, device.add, device.set), session.set Bpm 60 with the strike at beat 1: a reverse swell ending just before it, well under it; a snap, the meat, a 45-55 Hz fx.lowend sub-thud and the {{material}} layer, each trimmed to speak within 20 ms of its peak; debris under a closing fx.filter lane.set; one fx.verb return high-passed near 160 Hz that every layer feeds with track.send; the master ending in fx.limit at -4 dB and an fx.shaper hard clip. If a plan or render reply is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with its operationId.
3. Measure windows, unnormalized, into one probe `{{content_folder}}/SW_{{name}}_Probe`: hyper_sound_render StartSeconds 0 and DurationSeconds 0.95 (swell), 1 and 0.15 (strike), 2.5 and 0.5 (after the tail).
4. Render the whole with NormalizePeakDb -1 and bMetaSound true, then hyper_audio_validate the MetaSound.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: strike window LeadingSilenceSeconds under 0.02 (it lands at 1.00 s); swell PeakDb 12 dB or more under the strike's; after-tail window silent or 40 dB under; mix at -1 dB, not clipped, no Issues; MetaSound valid. Say the probe can be deleted.

presets.title: Make three variants of a creature roar
presets.summary: One set of performers across three roars: pitched vocal body with a sub, wet grit, glue and a grained tail in one space, measured per variant.

placeholders.name: library
placeholders.label: Sound library
placeholders.hint: a project folder of SoundWaves, or a folder of WAV files on disk

presets.prompt:
Make three variants of a {{creature}} roar, Decibel sessions `{{content_folder}}/DS_Roar_A`, `_B` and `_C`, with one set of performers so they sound like one throat. Follow the sound-design skill (vocal body, wet grit, glue, tail, one space); if the sound_design pack (Decibel) is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_memory_recall `{{creature}} audio`. hyper_sound_inspect with bCatalog and your DeviceIds. Find vocal, growl and texture takes in `{{library}}`.
2. Per variant, one hyper_sound_apply_plan (bCreate true, fresh operationId), each layer its own track (track.add, clip.audio, device.add, device.set): session.set Bpm 60 and OneShot 1; the vocal body down 3-7 semitones over a gen.synth sine at 40-55 Hz whose volume lane.set falls with the voice; wet grit micro-layers band-passed about 300 Hz-8 kHz, 6 dB under the voice; a saturated glue layer; a tail of the voice's last moment in StretchMode texture with a closing filter and a sinking pitch lane; one fx.verb return every track feeds with track.send. Variants swap takes, never performers. If a plan or render reply is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with its operationId.
3. hyper_sound_render each with NormalizePeakDb -1 and bMetaSound true; then, unnormalized, its body (StartSeconds 0.2, DurationSeconds 1) and last 0.5 s into one probe `{{content_folder}}/SW_Roar_Probe`.
4. hyper_audio_inspect the SoundWaves (projection metrics) and hyper_audio_validate the MetaSounds.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table per variant: length 2-4 s; PeakDb -1; not clipped; LeadingSilenceSeconds under 0.05; the last 0.5 s at least 10 dB under the body (RmsDb); no drone or click Issue. Say how the three differ; the probe can be deleted.

presets.title: Compose a quest-complete stinger in a hall
presets.summary: A rising bell arpeggio, a warm pad and a sub on the final chord, humanized, in one hall, rendered as a one-shot with a MetaSound.
presets.prompt:
Compose a {{seconds}} s quest-complete stinger in {{key}} from the Decibel session `{{content_folder}}/DS_Stinger_Quest`: a rising arpeggio on tuned synth bells, a warm pad, and a sub under the final chord, all in one hall. Follow the sound-design skill's Music recipe; if the sound_design pack (Decibel) is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_inspect with bCatalog, then DeviceId gen.synth (with bPresets) and fx.verb, for presets and parameter ids.
2. One hyper_sound_apply_plan (bCreate true, fresh operationId): session.set Bpm {{bpm}} and OneShot 1; a `Bells` track (track.add, device.add gen.synth, then device.preset or device.set for a bell tone) with a clip.midi arpeggio of the tonic triad over two octaves, humanized by a few ms and a little velocity; a `Pad` holding the tonic chord; a `Sub` on the root an octave down under the last chord; an fx return with fx.verb as a hall that every track feeds with track.send; a lane.set volume fade on the pad over the last beat. If a plan or render reply is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with its operationId.
3. hyper_sound_render with TailSeconds 2, bMetaSound true and NormalizePeakDb -1.
4. hyper_audio_validate the MetaSound.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: length {{seconds}} s plus the tail (within 0.3); PeakDb -1; not clipped; LeadingSilenceSeconds under 0.02; no Issues; MetaSound valid. List the notes you used with their MIDI numbers.

presets.title: Compose a looping menu music track
presets.summary: Whole bars of melody, chords, pad, bass and light percussion in one hall, phrased with lanes and rendered as a seamless music loop.
presets.prompt:
Compose a {{bars}}-bar {{mood}} menu music loop at {{bpm}} BPM from the Decibel session `{{content_folder}}/DS_Music_Menu`, looping seamlessly. Follow the sound-design skill's Music recipe; if the sound_design pack (Decibel) is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_inspect with bCatalog, then DeviceId gen.synth (with bPresets) and fx.verb, for presets and parameter ids.
2. One hyper_sound_apply_plan (bCreate true, fresh operationId): session.set Bpm {{bpm}}, TimeSigNumerator 4, TimeSigDenominator 4, Loop 1 from beat 0 to beat {{bars}} x 4; one gen.synth instrument track per part (track.add, device.add, device.set): melody, chords, pad, bass, and light percussion from short noise hits; humanized clip.midi notes; a hall fx return every track feeds with track.send; volume lane.set shaping 4-bar phrases; the last bar's chord leading back to the first. If a plan or render reply is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with its operationId.
3. hyper_sound_render with bLoop true, LoopTailSeconds 3, bMetaSound true and NormalizePeakDb -1.
4. hyper_audio_inspect the SoundWave (projection metrics) and hyper_audio_validate the MetaSound.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: length {{bars}} x 4 x 60 / {{bpm}} s (within 0.05); PeakDb -1; RmsDb between -20 and -14; not clipped; no loop Issue. List the parts with their note ranges.

presets.title: Audit the sound assets in a folder
presets.summary: Inspect and validate every SoundWave, Sound Cue and MetaSound under the folder: metrics, broken graphs and empty cues, without changing anything.
presets.prompt:
Audit the audio assets under {{content_folder}} and change nothing. If the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_project_search with kinds [asset] for SoundWaves, Sound Cues and MetaSounds under {{content_folder}}, to get their object paths.
2. hyper_audio_inspect with scope loaded_and_on_disk, those objectPaths and projection identity, metrics, references and details; page with the cursor until done.
3. hyper_audio_validate with the same scope and paths.
4. Flag: a MetaSound whose frontend is invalid; a Sound Cue with no nodes; a SoundWave with bad metrics (zero length, an unusual sample rate) or a one-shot longer than {{max_seconds}} s; unsaved loaded changes; anything the validator reports.
5. If one sample rate or channel layout holds for nearly every sound, hyper_memory_remember it as the project's convention, titled as the fact.
Reply with a PASS/FAIL table, one row per asset, worst first: kind, length, sample rate, channels and issues. Then counts per kind and the fixes you suggest; apply none.

presets.title: Check a footstep attenuation and concurrency plan
presets.summary: Dry-run an attenuation and a concurrency asset plan for footsteps, report the checked values and effects, and submit only if the build can apply it.
presets.prompt:
Check a plan for footstep audio: `{{content_folder}}/ATT_Footsteps.ATT_Footsteps` (inner radius {{inner}} cm, falloff {{falloff}} cm, natural sound curve, spatialized) and `{{content_folder}}/CON_Footsteps.CON_Footsteps` (at most {{max_count}} voices, the farthest stopped first). If the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_audio_inspect with scope loaded_and_on_disk and variants sound_attenuation and sound_concurrency, for assets with those names; if they exist, plan only configure ops for them.
2. hyper_audio_apply_plan with bDryRun true and operations: sound_attenuation.create, then sound_attenuation.configure with parameters inner_radius (float {{inner}}), falloff_distance (float {{falloff}}), distance_algorithm (string natural_sound), spatialize and attenuate (bool true); sound_concurrency.create, then sound_concurrency.configure with max_count (int {{max_count}}) and resolution_rule (string stop_farthest). Fix any operation it refuses, naming the field.
3. Submit once with bDryRun false, the dry run's planHash as expectedPlanHash and a fresh operationId. If the reply is staged_backend_required, this build's audio pack only checks plans: say so and stop, without making the assets another way.
4. If it completed, hyper_audio_validate both assets.
Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: the plan valid; its effects (creates and updates); each value as planned; the submit's outcome.

presets.title: Level-match a set of Decibel sounds to one peak
presets.summary: Measure each session as it stands, re-render all to one peak with MetaSounds, and flag the ones whose average level still stands out.
presets.prompt:
Re-render the Decibel sessions in {{content_folder}} whose names start with `{{prefix}}` so they sit at one peak of {{peak}} dBFS, each with a MetaSound. Change only their rendered SoundWaves and MetaSounds, never the sessions. Follow the sound-design skill's Measuring section; if the sound_design pack (Decibel) is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_inspect with bSessions for the sessions, then each SessionPath for its length and loop settings.
2. hyper_sound_render each once with no normalizing (fresh operationId) to measure PeakDb and RmsDb as it stands.
3. Render each again with NormalizePeakDb {{peak}} and bMetaSound true; for a looping session add bLoop with LoopCrossfadeSeconds 4 (a bed) or LoopTailSeconds 3 (music).
4. A peak does not match loudness: if a sound's RmsDb is more than 6 dB from the set's median, name it and suggest the change (a limiter drive, a quieter layer) instead of editing its session.
5. hyper_audio_inspect the SoundWaves (projection metrics) and hyper_audio_validate the MetaSounds.
Reply with a PASS/FAIL table, one row per sound: PeakDb before and after, RmsDb, within 6 dB of the median, not clipped, no Issues, MetaSound valid.

presets.title: Build a footstep cue that switches by surface
presets.summary: A Sound Cue with a surface switch, no-repeat random takes, pitch and volume variation, attenuation and a voice limit, laid out and validated.

placeholders.name: waves_folder
placeholders.label: Footstep SoundWaves folder
placeholders.hint: Holds the takes, named by surface (Stone, Grass).

presets.prompt:
Build `{{content_folder}}/SC_Footsteps`, a footstep Sound Cue that switches by surface. Follow the game-audio skill; if the audio_metasound tools are missing, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_asset_inspect with Folder `{{waves_folder}}`: list the SoundWaves for each of {{surfaces}} (2 to 8 per surface). Stop if a surface has none.
2. One hyper_sound_mix_plan (fresh OperationId): an attenuation `{{content_folder}}/ATT_Footsteps` (FalloffDistance 2500, DistanceAlgorithm NaturalSound, bAttenuateWithLPF true) and a concurrency `{{content_folder}}/CON_Footsteps` (MaxCount 4, ResolutionRule StopOldest). Dry-run it, then send it with bDryRun false; if it is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with bWaitThroughApproval true.
3. One hyper_sound_cue_plan: root an attenuation node on ATT_Footsteps, then a modulator (PitchMin 0.95, PitchMax 1.05, VolumeMin 0.85, VolumeMax 1), then a switch on Parameter `Surface` whose inputs are unset (the first surface again) and one random node per surface (bNoRepeat true) over that surface's wave players. Concurrency [CON_Footsteps]. Dry-run, read Nodes for the layout, then apply.
4. hyper_sound_asset_inspect the cue.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: every take in the graph, no error Issues, the switch has one input per surface plus unset, each random node no-repeat, attenuation and concurrency set, the cue saved. Say which Surface value plays which takes.

presets.title: Set up sound classes, a dialogue duck and a reverb bus
presets.summary: A Master, SFX, Music, Voice and UI class tree, a mix that ducks music under dialogue, and a world submix with reverb, EQ and a compressor.
presets.prompt:
Set up the project's mix under `{{content_folder}}/Mix` in one plan. Follow the game-audio skill; if the audio_metasound tools are missing, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_asset_inspect with Folder `{{content_folder}}/Mix`: stop if SCL_Master already exists and report what is there.
2. One hyper_sound_mix_plan, assets in this order: sound_class SCL_Master; SCL_SFX, SCL_Music (bIsMusic true), SCL_Voice and SCL_UI (bIsUISound true), each with Parent SCL_Master; sound_mix MIX_DialogueDuck with an adjuster on SCL_Music (Volume {{duck}}, bApplyToChildren true), FadeInTime 0.25, FadeOutTime 0.5, Duration -1; submix SMX_Master; submix SMX_World with Parent SMX_Master and Effects reverb (DecayTime {{decay}}, WetLevel 0.3), eq (a band at 250 Hz, -2 dB) and compressor (ThresholdDb -14, Ratio 3). Dry-run it and read Changes, then send it with bDryRun false and a fresh OperationId; hyper_operation_wait if it waits for approval.
3. hyper_sound_asset_inspect SCL_Master, MIX_DialogueDuck and SMX_World.
4. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: SCL_Master lists 4 children, the duck adjusts SCL_Music to {{duck}} with its fades, SMX_World's parent is SMX_Master with reverb, EQ and compressor in that order, everything saved.

presets.title: Generate sound effect takes and a random player
presets.summary: Paid: price several ElevenLabs takes of a sound effect, make them after approval, import them and play them through a no-repeat random MetaSound.

placeholders.name: sound
placeholders.label: The sound
placeholders.default: heavy oak door slams shut in a stone hall

presets.prompt:
Make {{takes}} takes of "{{sound}}" with ElevenLabs and a MetaSound that plays one at random. This spends real money: it runs only after my approval and never above {{max_cost}} USD. If the audio_generation tools are missing, say the pack is off and stop.
1. hyper_audio_generate with bDryRun true, Provider elevenlabs, Prompt "{{sound}}", DurationSeconds {{seconds}}, Variations {{takes}}, Folder `{{content_folder}}/Generated` and Wrap metasound_random. Report each take's Name, Seconds and Cost, EstimatedCost and WrapperPath. If EstimatedCost is above {{max_cost}} or the status is missing_key, stop and say why.
2. Send it again with bDryRun false and a fresh OperationId. Call hyper_operation_wait with that OperationId, bWaitThroughApproval true and TimeoutMs 120000, then hyper_audio_generate_status until the State is completed, failed or rejected.
3. hyper_sound_asset_inspect the wrapper and each take.
4. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: the job completed, {{takes}} SoundWaves imported with their lengths, the wrapper is a MetaSound Source with a Sounds input, the actual Cost at or under {{max_cost}} USD. List the asset paths and ask me to listen.

presets.title: Price a generated sound or music clip, spending nothing
presets.summary: Dry-run ElevenLabs and Stable Audio for the same request and compare each take's length and price, without spending anything.

placeholders.name: sound
placeholders.label: The sound or music
placeholders.default: gentle rain on leaves, steady, no thunder

presets.prompt:
Find out what "{{sound}}" ({{seconds}} s) would cost from each audio provider, without spending anything. Every call here is a dry run.
1. hyper_audio_generate_status with no OperationId: stop if this session already made it. If the audio_generation tools are missing, say the pack is off and stop.
2. hyper_audio_generate with bDryRun true, Prompt "{{sound}}", DurationSeconds {{seconds}} and Variations 1, once for each Provider: elevenlabs (only if {{seconds}} is 30 or less), elevenlabs_music, and stability. Read Providers to see which keys are set.
3. Do not call hyper_audio_generate with bDryRun false.
4. Reply with a table, one row per dry run: provider, model, Status (PASS when it is checked), take length, EstimatedCost in USD and DocsUrl. Say which is cheapest and remind me that a real take needs my approval.

presets.title: Build an engine hum MetaSound driven by RPM
presets.summary: Experimental: a procedural engine hum MetaSound Source with RPM, Cylinders, Load and Volume inputs, ready for a vehicle Blueprint to drive.
presets.prompt:
Build `{{content_folder}}/MS_EngineHum` from the experimental engine_hum recipe. Follow the game-audio skill; if the audio_metasound tools are missing, say so and stop.
1. hyper_metasound_recipe with an empty Recipe: read engine_hum's inputs and their ranges.
2. hyper_metasound_recipe with Recipe engine_hum, Path `{{content_folder}}/MS_EngineHum`, Inputs Cylinders {{cylinders}} and RPM {{idle_rpm}}, bDryRun true; then again with bDryRun false and a fresh OperationId, and hyper_operation_wait if it waits for approval.
3. hyper_sound_asset_inspect the new asset.
4. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: a MetaSound Source made, inputs RPM, Cylinders, Load and Volume exposed, defaults as asked. Then explain in two lines how a vehicle Blueprint drives it (an Audio Component's Set Float Parameter for RPM and Load each tick), and that the recipe is experimental and needs tuning by ear.

presets.title: Build footstep MetaSounds per surface from your takes
presets.summary: One no-repeat footstep MetaSound per surface from the project's own SoundWaves, rendered eight times each and checked for level, spread and onset.

placeholders.name: surfaces
placeholders.label: Surfaces
placeholders.hint: As the take names spell them

presets.prompt:
Make one footstep MetaSound per surface, `{{content_folder}}/MS_Footstep_<Surface>`, from the project's own takes in `{{waves_folder}}`. Follow the game-audio skill; if the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_asset_inspect with Folder `{{waves_folder}}`: group the SoundWaves by surface for each of {{surfaces}} (4 to 8 takes each, by name). Name a surface with fewer than 2 takes and skip it.
2. hyper_metasound_recipe with an empty Recipe: read footstep's inputs and their ranges.
3. Per surface, hyper_metasound_recipe with Recipe footstep, Path `{{content_folder}}/MS_Footstep_<Surface>`, its Waves, Inputs Pitch Jitter {{pitch_jitter}} and Volume Jitter {{volume_jitter}}, bDryRun true; then again with bDryRun false and a fresh OperationId. If it is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with that OperationId and bWaitThroughApproval true.
4. hyper_audio_analyze each new source with Plays 8 and MaxSeconds 2.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table, one row per surface: IntegratedLufs between -30 and -20 on every play, LoudnessSpreadLu between 1 and 3, PeakDb under -1, OnsetMs under 10, bFinished on every play, no Issues. If an Issue is named, fix it once (a different take set, less jitter) and analyze again.
6. Offer to play one with hyper_audio_preview (Action play, Sound the source): hearing it is mine, the numbers are yours.

presets.title: Make a layered impact with a delayed tail from your takes
presets.summary: An impact MetaSound whose crack and debris tail come from your SoundWaves, the tail a set delay later, measured for a sharp onset and a full finish.
presets.prompt:
Make `{{content_folder}}/MS_{{name}}`, an impact whose transient layer (the crack) comes from `{{hits_folder}}` and whose tail (debris, ring, room) comes from `{{tails_folder}}`, started {{tail_delay}} s after the hit. Follow the game-audio skill; if the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_asset_inspect with Folder `{{hits_folder}}`, then with Folder `{{tails_folder}}`: 2-6 short hits (under 0.5 s) and 2-6 tails. If either folder has none, say what is missing and stop.
2. hyper_metasound_recipe with Recipe impact, Path `{{content_folder}}/MS_{{name}}`, Waves the hits, Tails the tails, Inputs Tail Delay {{tail_delay}}, Transient Gain 1 and Tail Gain 0.7, bDryRun true. Read the inputs it reports, then send it with bDryRun false and a fresh OperationId; if it is awaiting_user_approval, hyper_operation_wait with bWaitThroughApproval true.
3. hyper_audio_analyze the source with Plays 6, MaxSeconds 5 and bEnvelope true.
4. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: OnsetMs under 5 on every play; PeakMs within 30 ms of the onset; TailSeconds at least 0.4 (the tail is heard); bFinished on every play; PeakDb under -1 and ClippedSamples 0; LoudnessSpreadLu under 4. If the envelope shows the tail landing late or burying the hit, change Tail Delay or Tail Gain once, through the recipe again, and analyze again.
5. Offer a hyper_audio_preview play of the source.

presets.title: Make a swept whoosh MetaSound with a tunable length
presets.summary: A whoosh from your takes, or pink noise when there are none, swept through a band pass, measured across plays and at twice its length.

placeholders.name: takes_folder
placeholders.label: Whoosh takes folder
placeholders.hint: With no takes there, the recipe sweeps pink noise

presets.prompt:
Make `{{content_folder}}/MS_{{name}}`, a whoosh swept from {{sweep_low}} Hz up to {{sweep_high}} Hz and back over {{length}} s. Follow the game-audio skill; if the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_asset_inspect with Folder `{{takes_folder}}` for 1-6 air or swish takes; with none, the recipe uses pink noise.
2. hyper_metasound_recipe with Recipe whoosh, Path `{{content_folder}}/MS_{{name}}`, Waves the takes (or none), Inputs Length {{length}}, Sweep Low {{sweep_low}} and Sweep High {{sweep_high}}, bDryRun true; then bDryRun false with a fresh OperationId, and hyper_operation_wait with bWaitThroughApproval true if it waits for approval.
3. hyper_audio_analyze with Plays 4 and bEnvelope true; then once more with Plays 1, bEnvelope true and Parameters Length set to twice {{length}}, to check the length follows the input.
4. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: DurationSeconds about {{length}} (within 0.15 s), and about twice that with the longer Length; the envelope rises then falls with its peak in the middle third; SpectralCentroidHz between {{sweep_low}} and {{sweep_high}}; bFinished; ClippedSamples 0; no Issues.
5. Offer a hyper_audio_preview play, then one with Parameters Length at the longer value.

presets.title: Turn ambience takes into an endless crossfading bed
presets.summary: A crossfade_loop MetaSound that moves between your ambience takes every segment, rendered long enough to hear the crossfades and checked for dips.

placeholders.name: segment
placeholders.label: Segment (s)
placeholders.hint: How long each take plays before the next fades in

presets.prompt:
Make `{{content_folder}}/MS_{{name}}`, an endless ambience bed that crossfades between the takes in `{{takes_folder}}` every {{segment}} s. Follow the game-audio skill; if the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_asset_inspect with Folder `{{takes_folder}}`: the beds, each longer than {{segment}} s. If there are none, say so and stop; one take is enough for a seamless loop.
2. hyper_metasound_recipe with Recipe crossfade_loop, Path `{{content_folder}}/MS_{{name}}`, Waves the beds, Inputs Segment {{segment}}, bDryRun true; then bDryRun false with a fresh OperationId, and hyper_operation_wait with bWaitThroughApproval true if it waits for approval.
3. hyper_audio_analyze with Plays 1, MaxSeconds 30 and bEnvelope true. A bed never finishes by design, so never_finishes is expected, and it fades in over its first segment.
4. Read the envelope after the first {{segment}} s: no dip deeper than 6 dB at a crossfade, and no jump between neighbouring 20 ms values that reads as a click.
5. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: a MetaSound Source made; after the fade-in, the level within 6 dB across the render; ClippedSamples 0; PeakDb under -3; no Issue but never_finishes. Then offer a hyper_audio_preview play and remind me it runs until Action stop.

presets.title: Build a custom MetaSound graph from searched nodes
presets.summary: Search the MetaSound node registry, read each node's pins, and wire a random-take player through a filter with exposed inputs, then render and measure it.
presets.prompt:
Build `{{content_folder}}/MS_{{name}}` as a graph of my own: each play picks a random take from `{{takes_folder}}`, shifts its pitch a little, and sends it through a low-pass filter whose cutoff is a graph input `Cutoff` (default {{cutoff}} Hz). Follow the game-audio skill's MetaSound graphs section; if the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_asset_inspect with Folder `{{takes_folder}}` for 2-8 SoundWaves.
2. hyper_metasound_node_search for each node: Query "random get" (a WaveAsset array), "wave player" (Mono), "random" with OutputType Float, and "state variable filter" or "one-pole low pass". hyper_metasound_node_describe those Classes for their pin names, types and defaults; never guess a pin.
3. hyper_metasound_graph_plan with Path `{{content_folder}}/MS_{{name}}`, Format mono, bOneShot true, Inputs `Takes` (WaveAsset:Array, the takes) and `Cutoff` (Float, {{cutoff}}), and Nodes and Connections: graph.On Play to the random get's and the player's triggers; the picked wave into the player's Wave Asset; a random float from -2 to 2 into its Pitch Shift; the player's audio through the filter, with Cutoff into its frequency, to graph.Out Mono; the player's On Finished to graph.On Finished. bDryRun true first and fix every refusal and warning, above all a one-shot that never finishes. Then bDryRun false with a fresh OperationId; hyper_operation_wait with bWaitThroughApproval true if it waits.
4. hyper_sound_asset_inspect the source: Takes and Cutoff are its inputs.
5. hyper_audio_analyze with Plays 4, then with Plays 1 and Parameters Cutoff 500.
6. Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: every play finished, ClippedSamples 0, LoudnessSpreadLu or CentroidSpreadHz above 0 (the takes vary), SpectralCentroidHz lower with Cutoff 500 than with {{cutoff}}, no Issues. List the node Classes used.

presets.title: Loudness-match a folder of SoundWaves to a LUFS target
presets.summary: Measure each SoundWave's integrated loudness, set its Volume so it lands on the target without pushing its peak past -1 dBFS, and report the gains.
presets.prompt:
Bring every SoundWave under `{{folder}}` to {{target}} LUFS integrated, within {{tolerance}} LU, through its Volume alone: change no samples and nothing else. If the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_memory_recall `audio loudness` for a project target; if one exists and differs from {{target}}, ask me which to use. hyper_sound_asset_inspect with Folder `{{folder}}` for the SoundWaves; read each one's current Volume with Epic's ObjectTools get_properties.
2. hyper_audio_analyze each SoundWave (it reads the imported samples): IntegratedLufs and PeakDb. Skip a silent one and name it.
3. Per sound, the gain in dB is {{target}} minus its IntegratedLufs. Cap it so PeakDb plus the gain stays at or under -1 dBFS, and flag a capped sound as needing a limiter rather than more volume. Its Volume is 10^(gain / 20), replacing the Volume it had.
4. Set each SoundWave's Volume with Epic's ObjectTools set_properties, one sound at a time, and read it back with get_properties.
5. hyper_audio_analyze reads samples, not Volume, so the loudness it will play at is IntegratedLufs + 20 x log10(Volume): compute it per sound.
6. Reply with a table, loudest first: sound, IntegratedLufs before, PeakDb, old and new Volume, expected LUFS, PASS within {{tolerance}} LU or CAPPED. If the project had no target, hyper_memory_remember {{target}} LUFS as its convention.
7. Offer to A/B the loudest and quietest with hyper_audio_preview play.

presets.title: Find clipping, silent and never-ending sounds in a folder
presets.summary: Render or read every SoundWave and MetaSound under the folder and list the ones that clip, start late, click at the seam or never finish.
presets.prompt:
Find the broken sounds under `{{folder}}` and change nothing. If the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_sound_asset_inspect with Folder `{{folder}}`: every SoundWave and MetaSound Source, with DurationSeconds (-1 means it loops, so it is not a one-shot). Sound Cues are not rendered: list them, and analyze their waves instead.
2. hyper_audio_analyze each one: a SoundWave once; a MetaSound with Plays 3 and MaxSeconds {{max_seconds}}.
3. Flag: ClippedSamples above 0 or a clipping Issue; silent; late_onset (OnsetMs above 30 on a one-shot); a one-shot MetaSound with bFinished false on any play (never_finishes: its On Finished is not wired); a loop with LoopSeamDb above -30 (clicks_at_seam); too_quiet or too_loud; no_variation on a MetaSound meant to vary.
4. Reply with a table, worst first: sound, kind, the failing numbers, the Issue, and the fix (re-export with headroom, trim the lead-in, wire On Finished with hyper_metasound_graph_plan, crossfade the loop). Then a count per Issue and how many passed. Apply nothing.

presets.title: Audition a sound in the mix with solo and mute
presets.summary: Play a sound in the editor, solo and mute Sound Classes while it plays, change its parameters and volume live, then clear everything you set.
presets.prompt:
Let me hear {{selected_asset}} in the mix, with solo and mute. Nothing is saved. If the audio_metasound pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_audio_preview with Action status: if bAudioAvailable is false, say this editor has no audio device and stop. Note what already plays and any solos or mutes.
2. hyper_sound_asset_inspect {{selected_asset}} (its inputs, if it is a MetaSound, and its Sound Class), `{{solo_class}}` and `{{mute_class}}`, to confirm both classes exist.
3. hyper_audio_preview Action play with Sound {{selected_asset}}; Action solo with Target `{{solo_class}}` and bEnable true; Action status; then Action solo with bEnable false, Action mute with Target `{{mute_class}}`, and Action status.
4. If it has an input `{{parameter}}`, Action set with Parameters {{parameter}} {{value}}; then Action set with VolumeMultiplier 0.5 and PitchMultiplier 1.1. Before each step, tell me what I should hear, and ask what I heard.
5. Action clear, Action stop, then Action status.
Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: an audio device present; the sound in ActiveSounds after play; `{{solo_class}}` in Soloed and `{{mute_class}}` in Muted while set; the parameter accepted, or not an input; and at the end Soloed and Muted empty with nothing previewing.
